scope: Public-source methodology and offline experiments only; no real-data advantage or executable betting strategy established.
shared_preregistration_required: Consecutive eligible population and fixed train, validation and final-test dates
Observable decision schedule, target horizon, target price definition and feature availability cutoff
Missingness, suspensions, late starts, non-runners and unscorable-case policies
Model family, feature groups, hyperparameter search budget and complete trial ledger
One primary metric, minimum useful improvement and uncertainty/multiplicity policy
Calendar/group splits, label-overlap purge, availability gap and final-test access log

shared_temporal_contract.rule: Features must describe events and versions available no later than the declared cutoff. A past event date alone is insufficient. Fit transformations on training folds only.
shared_temporal_contract.receipt_time: Use genuine historical receipt evidence when claiming delivery latency; do not treat the date of a later bulk download as historical receipt time.
shared_temporal_contract.unknown_availability: Exclude from strict historical claims or label explicit availability assumptions; never silently infer availability from event time.
shared_temporal_contract.schedule: Anchor decisions to information observable then; do not choose decision timestamps retrospectively from actual off time.
shared_temporal_contract.runner_set: Preserve the field known at the decision, with a preregistered policy for subsequent removals and scoring.

shared_gates.invalid_experiment: Reject results with leakage, unresolved entity joins or post hoc exclusions. Correct the design before further evaluation.
shared_gates.forecast_rejection: A frozen variant with no useful held-out gain fails its stated claim for that specification; insufficient precision is inconclusive.
shared_gates.forecast_promotion: Advance only when a preregistered confidence bound for paired score improvement exceeds the preregistered minimum useful improvement, with registered multiplicity control and planned robustness checks. Promotion means more research, not betting approval.
shared_gates.economic_promotion: Requires a separate future execution simulation with obtainable prices, queue/delay/fill assumptions, adverse cases and all applicable costs. No current card has passed this gate.
shared_gates.threshold_note: Null values deliberately mean not registered. They must be frozen before final-test inspection, not chosen to fit results.

cards.title: Incremental price and volume information
cards.question: Does lagged price/volume/depth information improve a fixed-horizon pre-off price forecast beyond simple price baselines?
cards.plausible_mechanism: Persistent order imbalance or changes in participation may precede further repricing.
cards.counterhypothesis: Current prices already incorporate these observations; apparent persistence reflects stale quotes, mechanical sampling or future leakage.
required_predecision_data: Timestamped best back/lay prices and corresponding available sizes
Traded volume updates with clear delta-versus-cumulative semantics
Market status, runner IDs and field membership as known then
Enough predecision history to construct registered lookbacks without later values
cards.target: Change from the declared decision-time price to the same price definition at a fixed later horizon; exact horizon and missing-target policy await registration.
baselines: Simple momentum using a registered lookback
Price-only model with the same training/tuning budget

metrics.primary: Paired reduction in absolute forecast error in a declared tick or probability scale
secondary: Directional accuracy including a defined no-change class
Error by liquidity and calendar block

ablations: Refit without volume/depth features using identical calendar folds
Predeclared training-size learning curve with fixed evaluation dates
Apply staleness limits and additional availability delay
cards.reject_if: The extra feature group adds no useful held-out improvement, or its gain requires stale/after-cutoff data or one exceptional meeting.
cards.promote_if: Shared forecast gate passes against each registered baseline and the increment survives volume-group removal comparisons and delay stress.
cards.local_v1: Replay public stream deltas into pre-off LTP snapshots and score fixed no-change, momentum and mean-reversion candidates with market-balanced errors. The one-meeting 2017 sample is an engineering check, not a holdout or a trained price/volume model.
cards.future_work: Acquire permitted depth/volume data; train and compare models; quantify blocked uncertainty and execution sensitivity.

cards.title: Information linking runners within a market
cards.question: Do lagged competitor movements improve the same target forecast beyond the runner's own history and contemporaneous market state?
cards.plausible_mechanism: Relative repricing and changes in volume distribution may convey information not yet reflected equally across runners.
cards.counterhypothesis: The relationship is mechanical normalization, shared market movement, synchronized stale data or post hoc selection of the eventual favourite.
required_predecision_data: All E01 fields across the then-known field, with per-runner freshness
Stable cross-runner market joins without later field membership
Price rank and market shares computed only at the decision cutoff
cards.target: Same registered price definition and horizon as E01; reuse identical eligible races and calendar splits.
baselines: Own-runner model plus current market rank and normalized price shares

metrics.primary: Paired reduction in fixed-horizon absolute forecast error relative to the strongest registered own-runner baseline
secondary: Performance by field size and spread

ablations: Remove all other-runner lagged features as one group and refit
Retain current market shares but remove competitor history
Compare complete-case and preregistered missingness-aware results without hiding exclusions
cards.reject_if: The increment vanishes after controlling for current shares, consistent timestamps or whole-group removal, or depends on a field/rank known only later.
cards.promote_if: Shared forecast gate passes relative to the full own-runner baseline with synchronized data and registered group ablations.
cards.local_v1: Validate market/runner timing and score a fixed cross-runner linkage candidate on replayed LTP snapshots. No fitted linkage model or cross-runner advantage is established by the sample.
cards.future_work: Fit linked-feature models only after reliable all-runner coverage and E01 baselines exist.

cards.title: Earlier performance beyond market probabilities
cards.question: Do genuinely earlier published performance features improve future race-outcome probabilities beyond a calibrated market-only benchmark?
cards.plausible_mechanism: Pace-conditioned previous sectionals may encode information that is incompletely represented by headline finishing positions.
cards.counterhypothesis: The market already prices the information, or improvement comes from revised ratings/pars, target-race sectionals or selective data coverage.
required_predecision_data: Stable horse/race IDs joining previous starts to each target race
Earlier-start sectionals, total times and contextual distance/surface/going with publication/version evidence
Predecision executable price snapshot and the then-known runner set
Historical rating-at-race/publication evidence if ratings are included; otherwise omit them
cards.target: Future race outcome under a registered policy for later withdrawals, voids and dead heats; target-race measurements are labels only.
baselines: Market-only calibration fitted on training folds
Uniform field probabilities as a sanity check only

metrics.primary: Paired reduction in race-level log loss against market-only calibration

ablations: Refit without the entire previous-sectional feature group
Keep market information but remove all added performance information
Exclude revised or availability-unknown features and report the changed population
cards.reject_if: No useful held-out improvement survives as-of availability checks, market-only calibration and the registered feature-group comparison.
cards.promote_if: Shared forecast gate passes on untouched later races, with improved proper scores and no unacceptable preregistered calibration degradation.
cards.local_v1: Implement point-in-time entity-join contracts only. No fitted outcome model or probability-validation claim. The two-race archive remains descriptive, not a test set.
cards.future_work: Acquire consecutive historical performance and predecision prices, train calibration/models, and evaluate enough independent calendar blocks for meaningful uncertainty.

cards.title: A predictive increment that survives delay
cards.question: Does a frozen signal retain useful incremental forecast quality at achievable data-availability and computation delays?
cards.plausible_mechanism: An information effect may persist long enough for a modest local pipeline to observe and process it.
cards.counterhypothesis: Signal value disappears before the input is available, or an elaborate model's additional score gain is smaller than its delay-induced degradation.
required_predecision_data: Frozen model/feature definition from a separate training period
Publication timestamps and genuine receipt timestamps where historical latency is claimed
Measured preprocessing/inference start and finish times on the target device
A preregistered delay grid, data resolution and staleness/missingness policy
cards.target: Same fixed decision/horizon as the underlying forecast; an input at decision minus delay is available only under the registered timestamp rule.
baselines: Simple forecast using information genuinely available at that decision
Frozen model under zero added delay as an optimistic reference only
Simpler model with measured computation time

metrics.primary: Retention of paired forecast-score improvement under each registered realistic delay scenario

ablations: Hold the model fixed while delaying all its required inputs coherently
Compare model complexity at the same available-information deadline
Separate observed delivery delay from hypothetical stress scenarios
cards.reject_if: Useful improvement requires earlier-than-supported input availability or disappears at measured/credible total delays.
cards.promote_if: Shared forecast gate survives the registered realistic delay range; historical assumptions remain explicitly conditional where receipt evidence is missing.
cards.local_v1: Inject declared data-delay scenarios into fixed forecasts and record offline replay/scoring runtime. These are sensitivity scenarios, not measured historical feed, network, VPS or exchange-order latency.
cards.future_work: Collect defensible timing evidence and replay at appropriate granularity; any economic claim additionally requires the separate execution gate.
